reason: I'd download it and use the free part, but I wouldn't pay. Three questions a day is already more than I'd ever ask about kra pao or a pork omelet, and I learn those from free clips before bed anyway.
objection: It's only two dishes I mostly already know, and nothing about how much oil, salt or calories goes in, which is the whole reason I cook at home. Paying 99 baht a month, almost two plates from the stall, just to ask more questions feels pointless.
would_change_my_mind: If the membership gave me lots of healthy one-pan dishes that show calories and how to cut oil and salt, not just more questions.
